description: Conceptual permission model used by agents and tasks.

permissions.description: Perform analysis and produce findings without modifying state.
Create or modify documentation and non-code artifacts.
Create or modify memory records and knowledge artifacts.
Create or modify code and configuration within an authorized scope.
Deploy to a non-production or explicitly authorized environment.
Delete data, drop resources or perform irreversible operations.

rules: DESTRUCTIVE is never granted by default and requires explicit human authorization.
DEPLOY requires explicit authorization and a defined rollback procedure.
No agent may bypass a gate or self-approve a manual gate condition.
IMPLEMENT, TEST and DEPLOY are additionally scoped by a task's authorized_actions.
An agent may never grant itself more permissions than its definition declares.
